turns.label: Brief
turns.prompt:
Design a vertical A4 menu for a small neighborhood brunch café called "Sunday Fern".
Three sections: Coffee, Brunch Plates, Fresh Juices — four items each. For every item include the name, a one-line description and a price in USD. Use realistic sample items and prices so I can swap them later.
Style: off-white textured paper, deep green ink, a clean serif for headings and a readable sans for body text, small hand-drawn botanical line illustrations, generous margins.
Make sure each price lines up clearly with its item and nothing is crowded at A4 print size.
Deliver a PNG for viewing and an editable SVG source file.
turns.reply:
I've designed the Sunday Fern menu as an editable A4 SVG. The PNG will be exported automatically from it.

**Layout**
- **Header:** a small three-leaf sprig sits above "Sunday Fern" in Didot. Below it are a letter-spaced subtitle, a leaf divider and the opening hours. Two fern fronds frame the header from the top corners.
- **Sections:** Coffee, Brunch Plates and Fresh Juices each have a centred Didot heading and a small leaf-and-rule divider.
- **Items:** each name is in Avenir Next Demi. A dotted leader runs to a price, and every price is right-aligned on the same vertical edge. The one-line description sits underneath in a lighter green.
- **Spacing:** the side margins are about 300 px, with a double rule border inside the paper edge. Items are spaced 140 px apart and sections about 150 px apart, so nothing is crowded at print size.
- **Footer:** a short allergy and milk-options note, with small fronds in the bottom corners.
- **Paper:** the off-white texture is drawn with SVG noise filters, so the file stays self-contained.

**Editing tips**
- All text is live. Prices are right-aligned, so changing their length won't break the alignment.
- The dotted leaders are sized by estimate. If you make a dish name much longer, move that line's first `x1` value to the right.

[[file:sunday-fern-menu.svg]]

turns.label: Self-check
turns.prompt: Here is the PNG rendered from the SVG you just delivered, at half size. Check it the way you would before sending it to a print shop: overlapping or clipped text, prices on one clean right edge, nothing crowded at A4 size, illustrations legible, margins even. If anything needs fixing, deliver the corrected SVG under the same file name. If it is ready, say so in one or two sentences and deliver nothing.
turns.reply:
The leaders were the main problem. The gap between each dish name and its first dot ranged from about 75 px to 190 px. Their right ends also sat closer to the longer $xx.xx prices than to the $x.xx prices. Prices already share one clean right edge, and nothing overlaps or clips.

**Fixes in this version:**
- **Leaders:** each leader now starts about 40 px after its name and stops about 40 px before its price, so every row has the same spacing.
- **Footer spacing:** the footer note was only 100 px below the last juice, tighter than the rest of the page. I moved Brunch Plates up 25 px and Fresh Juices up 50 px. The footer now has the same 140 px breathing room as the items.

[[file:sunday-fern-menu.svg]]

turns.label: Edit in the same task
turns.prompt: Update the SVG: change the three Coffee prices to $4.50, $5.25 and $5.75, make all prices slightly larger so they read well when printed, and add a footer line "Oat and almond milk available · Ask us about gluten-free options". Keep everything else. Save as "sunday-fern-menu-v2.svg" and export a matching PNG.
turns.reply:
I've made all three changes and saved the file as **sunday-fern-menu-v2.svg**. The PNG will be exported automatically under the same name.

**Changes**
- **Coffee prices:** your list has three prices but the section has four drinks. I applied them in order: Espresso is now $4.50, Oat Milk Flat White $5.25 and Sunday Fern Latte $5.75. Cold Brew stays at $4.50. If you meant different items, just swap the numbers in the price lines of the Coffee section.
- **Price size:** prices are up from 48 px to 56 px, about 14 pt at print size. They stay bold, right-aligned on the same edge and on the same baseline as the dish names. I shortened the dotted leaders to keep the same gap of about 40 px before each price.
- **Footer:** I added "Oat and almond milk available · Ask us about gluten-free options" as a second footer line. Both lines sit well inside the border and clear of the corner fronds.

You may want to review the original footer line ("Oat, almond or soy milk +$0.75 · …"). It overlaps with the new one, so you could delete it or reword it.

[[file:sunday-fern-menu-v2.svg]]
